text: Evidence: frameJVM/test and frameJS/test pass 40/40; frameFs2JS/test passes 8/8; frameFs2JVM/test passes 9/9. Source capabilities and requested/accepted/residual receipts keep unsupported predicate/batch-size pushdown visible; in-memory projection+limit reads only selected columns and terminates early; CSV is explicit-schema, quote/null/NaN aware on JVM+JS; Apache Arrow Java 19 IPC roundtrip passes on JVM with bool/int/float/UTF-8/null/timestamp fidelity; source/sink errors and ownership are structured.
